name: Counterparty institution slow or unresponsive to fraud recall and information requests
description: A correspondent, payment institution or exchange repeatedly fails to act on freeze, recall or request-for-information messages in time, or the same beneficiary institution appears in many fraud cases.
fp: Time-zone differences, legal process requirements in the counterparty's jurisdiction and capacity limits can delay legitimate responses.

sources.text: FATF, INTERPOL and Egmont Group, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-enabled Fraud (2023)
FATF, Recommendation 16 (payment transparency) revisions and Interpretive Note (2025)
FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services (2016)

links.name: Counterparty institution slow or unresponsive to fraud recall and information requests
links.ctx: Weak responsiveness at downstream hops lets proceeds disperse; it informs counterparty risk rating and routing decisions.
